race.description: Diego Velazquez By Frankel @ Swettenham Hcp (Bm62)
race.comment: Tricky race. ILLUMINANCE (9) finds it tough to win but is very consistent with 11 runner-up efforts from 23 starts. Two runs back have been good, beaten the barest of margins at Cranbourne second up. She should get a nice run here and be right there again. I SAID SO (17) is a 5yo gelding who just bumped into one first up at Bairnsdale. He should come on from that and take holding out. BELLA PIETRA (14) can mix her form but the run two back has her in the mix. Ethan Brown takes the ride which helps. UNAPPROACHABLE (12) comes back in grade off an even showing in town. She maps ideally and can bounce back.
